svg.aria-label: A kaizen suggestion file, annotated. Its path is the feedback folder, the skill name and a dated slug, and its id is target, skill and file name. The frontmatter holds skill, date, outcome, severity, the scope file the fix lands in, and a status that is only ever open, fixed or dropped. Context, Suggestion and Evidence sections follow. Later a Recurrence section is appended if the problem happens again, and kaizen close records fixed with a commit sha or dropped with a reason.
